metadata.description: Public-safe Claude Code plugins from Tripti: the Alpha Academic API client (needs an API key) and the TimeBack/QTI platform reference (Ilma's, no key).

plugins.name: alpha-academic-remote
plugins.description: Ask Alpha Schools academic questions by calling the private Alpha Academic API. No data bundled — everything served over HTTPS from the API. Requires ALPHA_API_KEY env var.

plugins.name: timeback
plugins.description: TimeBack / QTI platform reference (authored by Ilma — ilmych/incept-timeback-plugin, public, canonical). Prevents XML/QTI/rendering/API bugs when building TimeBack content; includes the read-side API references (OneRoster, PowerPath, EduBridge, QTI, Cognito auth). No API key.
